description: Step 2 - coupled-EM group prior training. Mode B only. Variants: gMSHBM + dMSHBM (cMSHBM has no xyz-vMF path in the master kernel; Step2Config raises NotImplementedError).
source_note: `source` fields name the file owning the field's authoritative default. Line numbers are intentionally omitted — they drift on every reformat and the file/symbol name is the stable contract.
range_policy: advisory — `min`/`max` fields are UI hints documenting the values authors have validated; the parser/validator enforces only positivity (numeric fields) and enum membership (enum fields). Out-of-range-but-positive values are accepted at parse time.

entries.notes: GPU is 13-16x faster but bound by VRAM (s_lambda buffer ~19.7 GB at S=200/L=300).

entries.description: Opt-in TF32 cuBLAS sgemm math mode for step2.
entries.notes: ~15% step2 em_total speedup, rel-drift ~1e-4 on cost. Relocated from top-level ``enable_tf32_step2`` into the step2 block in 2026-06. Mode A configs no longer carry this field at all (the entire step2 block is forbidden in Mode A), so the previous Mode-A-writes-true-silently-does-nothing footgun is gone by construction.
